about.en: Sapling is a Zcash-native token launchpad on Solana: every coin launched there trades against ZEC, and a share of each coin's trading fees accumulates in an on-chain vault — its "roots" — denominated in ZEC, which holders can claim by burning the coin. SAPLING is the platform's own token, at BZFYNPeQAEW3HWQ4DNsTVahC1n4ZjTgn6jB2nnBbB96W on Solana.
